276573161.description: This mixed lot weighs approximately 4.2lbs and includes collectible minerals, crystals, and fossils. The set features polished and rough stones, geodes with purple and clear crystals, a quartz crystal point, and a quartz crystal cluster. Included is a specimen of coprolite (dinosaur poop) estimated to be around 50 million years old. Additional items include tumbled stones, an obsidian arrowhead, and various unique mineral specimens in multiple colors and shapes. All items are in good used or natural condition with no obvious damage, suitable for collectors, educational use, or display.

Included accessories are a screwdriver, tube opener, spare parts, and an instruction manual. All items are housed in a brown leather carrying case featuring a latch and handle. The kit is in good used condition with some visible wear on tools and packaging. Suitable for collectors, educational purposes, or demonstration use.
